justification: A white blood cell count of 1,000,000,000 cells/µL (1 billion cells/µL) is physiologically implausible; normal WBC ranges from 4,500-11,000 cells/µL, and even severe leukemia rarely exceeds 500,000-1,000,000 cells/µL, making this value approximately 1,000-fold higher than any survivable pathological extreme.
